question: A TSO has to cut back long-term cross-border capacity that is already allocated. Whom does it ask to launch the coordinated calculation of the necessary curtailments, and what must it supply with the request?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 25(2) of Regulation 2016/1719 says the TSO sends a request to the responsible coordinated capacity calculator to launch the coordinated calculation of necessary curtailments, and supports the request with all relevant information. verdict.gold_reason: Article 25(2) of Regulation 2016/1719 says the TSO sends a request to the responsible coordinated capacity calculator to launch the coordinated calculation of necessary curtailments, and supports the request with all relevant information. The reference answer matches this.
